composition: User-approved cloudless coastal panorama with more sky, a sandy Santa Monica-inspired beach and a thin strip of Pacific Ocean. Hollywood remains on the left hillside and the small USC campus stays within a flat urban neighborhood inland. The final day edit removes clouds from the revised coastal framing; dawn, sunset and night use that cloudless day image as their sole composition reference.

prompts.day:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Los Angeles coastal desktop background, one full-bleed landscape 3:2 illustration, 1536x1024.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact composition reference.
Change ONLY the sky: REMOVE ALL CLOUDS. The user explicitly wants no clouds. Replace every white or cream cloud, streak, wisp and cloud bank above and behind the skyline with a CLEAR natural blue sky, with a gentle blue gradient becoming slightly paler near the mountains. Fine subtle painterly/dithered sky texture is acceptable, but there must be absolutely no cloud shapes, white wisps, streaks or patches. No sun disk, moon, stars, birds or aircraft.
Preserve EXACTLY the input's current more-sky/less-water framing: mountain ridge, skyline and city positions, all building shapes and sizes, the small USC campus, palms, urban greenery, coastal houses, beach, shoreline and the thin ocean strip along the bottom. Do not move the city or change the amount of sky or water. Do not change the mountain textures or confuse hills with clouds. Preserve the same late-morning daylight, colors, fine dithered editorial pixel-painting style and 3:2 dimensions.
Keep exactly "HOLLYWOOD" on the left hillside and exactly "USC" in gold once on its small cardinal-red campus banner. Do not add objects, labels, borders, logos, UI or watermarks. Return one finished cloudless DAY image.
